records.name: Vue UDataView
records.purpose: Present a collection in list or grid layout with optional paging, sorting, lazy-load notification, loading and empty states.
records.surface: UDataView and createBaseDataView (componentName dataview); source-only dataViewStyleModule. Props: value, layout list|grid (default list), paginator, first, rows, totalRecords, rowsPerPageOptions, paginatorPosition (default bottom), alwaysShowPaginator (default true), currentPageReportTemplate (default "{first} to {last} of {totalRecords}" with {currentPage}, {totalPages} and {rows} also substituted), sortField, sortOrder, lazy, loading, loadingIcon (default class u-loading-icon on a span with role status, alongside USpinnerIcon from @ultimate/vue-core), emptyMessage (default "No results found"), dataKey, trackBy and itemTemplate (item) => string. Emits page, lazy-load, update:first and update:rows. Non-exported helpers field(), compare() and pageNumber() sort and page non-lazy data; lazy-load is emitted on mount and when first, rows, sortField, sortOrder or lazy change, with {first, rows, sortField, sortOrder}. Scoped slots grid and list receive {items}; default items render as div role listitem with text interpolation of itemTemplate. It composes the Paginator SFC from ../paginator/Paginator.vue (identity owned by #133) and a rows-per-page select labelled Rows per page, plus an aria-live page report. It declares no filter. Each is an Options API SFC extending its exported base factory, which extends createBaseComponent from @ultimate/vue-core; the family barrel exposes the same named surface at the root and at the family subpath, and declared dist paths do not establish publication. The style module is source-only: exported from its style file, not from the family barrel. No component-metadata record or @ultimate/uix-styles entry exists for this family in this revision. The Aura preset registration does not prove rendered appearance. Prime references in source are neutral provenance context.
